en.headline: Hong Kong thrash Laos 4-0 in FIFA ASEAN Cup opener at Kai Tak
en.dek: Sun Ming-him, Everton Camargo, Dudu and Matt Orr scored as nearly 19,000 fans watched the hosts take control of Group A on Sunday afternoon.
body: Hong Kong, China opened their FIFA ASEAN Cup Division 2 campaign with a convincing 4-0 win over Laos at Kai Tak Stadium on Sunday, climbing to the top of Group A in front of 18,873 spectators.

Sun Ming-him headed in from an Everton Camargo corner in the 12th minute to give the hosts the lead. Camargo doubled the advantage himself in the 33rd minute with a powerful finish after a solo run. Dudu added a third from another corner six minutes after the break, and substitute Matt Orr converted a late penalty to complete the scoring.

Sports minister Rosanna Law, who attended the match, said the performance was outstanding and the result fully deserved. She praised the team's energetic, high-tempo display and the passionate support from the home crowd that created a sea of red.
Hong Kong next face Brunei at Kai Tak on Wednesday evening. A draw would be enough to secure a place in the Division 2 final.

zh.headline: 東盟盃港隊4:0大勝老撾 啟德近1.9萬人見證
zh.dek: 孫銘謙、艾華頓、杜度及安永佳各建一功，港隊在A組暫列榜首，羅淑佩讚戰果具說服力。
body: 中國香港男子足球代表隊周日下午在啟德主場館舉行的國際足協東盟盃第二級別賽事首戰，以4比0大勝老撾，在A組全取3分暫列榜首，吸引18,873名球迷入場。
上半場12分鐘，孫銘謙接應艾華頓角球頭槌破網先開紀錄。33分鐘，艾華頓個人突破後勁射入網，半場領先兩球。下半場55分鐘，杜度再以頭槌將比分擴大至3比0。完場前，後備安永佳射入十二碼鎖定勝局。
文化體育及旅遊局局長羅淑佩到場觀賽後表示，港隊表現十分出色，踢法主動且節奏明快，4比0戰果合理且具說服力，令接近19,000名球迷看得非常興奮。她形容球員90分鐘全力拚搏，球迷傾力打氣，現場再現「紅海」，氣氛一流。
港隊下一場將於周三晚上在啟德對陣汶萊，只要打和即可晉級決賽。
